mentions.name: VisitorQuery
mentions.description: A proxy and VPN detection tool that classifies connections based on the specifics of the connection itself rather than relying on static lists or known proxy/VPN databases, making it effective at detecting residential proxies and VPNs.
mentions.problem: List- and database-based proxy/VPN detection tools are ineffective at catching residential proxies and VPNs.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://visitorquery.com a proxy & VPN detecting tool that does it's thing based on the specifics of a connection rather than parsing list and known databases which makes it very effective against residential ones too.
